48th Independence Day Observed
2018-03-31T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/showbiz/event/48th-independence-day-observed-1555783

26th March marked our country's 48th Independence Day. Recently, Bangladesh has reached the status of a middle-income country. To celebrate this momentous pair of achievements, the Ministry of Planning of Bangladesh organized a star-studded event full of fireworks, visual projections and live performances. The stars of the Bangladeshi showbiz industry showed their love and adoration for our beloved country at this grand show in Hatirjheel, which was executed by One More Zero Communications. The likes of Habib, Hridoy Khan, Rezwana Choudhury Bannya, Mim, Fahmida Nabi, Ferdous and Toma Mirza graced the stage. We bring you some exclusive pictures from the special night!
